d: Badhrah Investment Company is a Saudi startup based in Buraidah, operating in the construction and real estate development sectors. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and hands-on Accountant to support our growing operations and help build strong financial processes from an early stage.

The successful candidate will be responsible for day-to-day accounting, project cost tracking, financial reporting, reconciliations, and compliance support. This role requires close coordination with management, project teams, contractors, suppliers, and external advisers.
Previous experience in construction, contracting, project accounting, or real estate development is strongly preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field.
Experience in construction, contracting, project accounting, property development, or real estate is strongly preferred.
Good understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and cost control.
Practical knowledge of Saudi VAT and electronic invoicing requirements is preferred.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience using an accounting system or ERP platform.
Professional working proficiency in Arabic and the ability to communicate effectively in English.
